source_snapshot.items: NT.8_ConnectX-8 GPU Direct Test in Dual port ethernet networking mode (2x 400G ETH)
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; run NVQual Test #38; collect results/photos and inspect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All items should be passed without system hang or reboot.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 60 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires NVQual, ConnectX/BlueField and GPUDirect setup and warns of saturation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for both port/peer paths, Ethernet distribution semantics, GDR proof, per-port/aggregate limits, isolation and recovery.

old_problem: An aggregate Test #38 result can pass while one 400G port is idle, misrouted or faulting. The two physical ports/peers, Ethernet mode, bonding or independent-flow placement, direct-memory path, per-port balance/integrity limits and recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row explicitly defines dual-port 2x400G Ethernet GPUDirect. Exact port/peer/switch mappings, distribution policy, traffic matrix and signed per-port/aggregate limits are Project Configuration. ED-05 requires Ethernet-specific validation distinct from IB; a parameterized gate resolves review while forbidding single-port or aggregate-only substitution.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2144, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2145 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00022-V002 / 7c3102fc512a47e1 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the pinned Test #38 profile, GPU UUID/BDF, HCA serial/BDF, both physical ports/MACs/netdevs, switch/peer paths and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU topology.
Prove both links at 400G Ethernet with signed MTU/VLAN/routing and bonding or independent-flow semantics plus direct GPU-memory registration.
Pin flow-to-port placement, directions, payloads, queues/streams, concurrency, 60-minute duration and signed per-port/aggregate performance, balance, integrity, congestion and error limits.
Isolate both non-production Ethernet paths, preserve/hash per-port/switch/NIC/PCIe/host baselines, and retain complete separate plus aggregate raw evidence.

Stop on silent single-port fallback, wrong peer, unacceptable imbalance, loss/corruption, congestion/drop, link flap, AER/NIC/GPU fault, thermal/power breach, hang/reboot or evidence gap; never reset/retry.
No NVQual/Ethernet/GDR traffic, link query, network drain, log clearing, routing/LAG change, HCA/GPU/switch reset, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Dual-path 2x400G Ethernet HGX NVQual Test #38 GPUDirect qualification
test_case.purpose: Exercise both exact ConnectX-8 400G Ethernet GPUDirect paths and prove per-port plus aggregate performance and integrity under the approved distribution policy without port flap, device fault, unsafe congestion, hang or reboot.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #38 and compatible GPU/ConnectX-8/CUDA/driver/firmware/DOCA-MOFED stack
Signed GPU/HCA identities, both port MAC/netdev/physical identities, two switch/peer paths and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU map
Approved two-link 400G Ethernet MTU/VLAN/routing and bonding or independent-flow placement plus GDR proof
Dedicated drained SUT, isolated dual Ethernet paths, synchronized telemetry, abort and coordinated recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash both-port, switch, NIC, PCIe and host baselines and isolate the two paths. Verify each 400G Ethernet link, approved distribution policy and direct-memory registration, then run only the pinned Test #38 profile for 60 minutes. Retain independent per-port and aggregate traffic, integrity, balance, congestion and health evidence. Stop on first fallback or anomaly; do not reconfigure/reset/retry.
test_case.expected_result: Both bound physical ports remain active at approved 400G Ethernet and carry their signed flows; each per-port and aggregate result meets performance, balance, integrity, congestion and error limits; endpoints and platform remain healthy with no flap, hang or reboot.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until both paths, Ethernet/distribution/GDR configuration, workload and signed limits are bound. PASS requires accepted separate and aggregate evidence for every profile. FAIL on idle/wrong/misrouted port, silent single-port fallback, wrong peer, unacceptable imbalance, corruption/loss, threshold miss, congestion/drop, flap/device fault, thermal/power breach, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; aggregate-only or IB output is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until both port/peer paths, Ethernet/distribution/GDR configuration, workload, limits and recovery are signed.
Use a drained dedicated SUT and isolate both non-production Ethernet paths; preserve all baselines.
Do not alter production routing/VLAN/LAG policy; monitor each port, switch, PCIe/NIC/GPU and thermal/power state.
Stop without network reconfiguration, HCA/GPU/switch reset or automatic retry on first fallback or fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #38 profile and network authorization
GPU/HCA identities, both physical ports/MACs/netdevs, switch/peer paths and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU map
Both raw 400G Ethernet states, MTU/VLAN/routing/bonding or flow-placement config and GDR proof
Both switch/peer congestion/drop/error counters plus NIC/GPU/PCIe/kernel/BMC/SEL/thermal/power evidence
First-fault coordinated recovery or verified clean final two-port state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On single-port fallback, wrong peer, imbalance, corruption/loss, congestion/drop, flap or device/platform fault, stop both flows and preserve first-fault artifacts. Do not change routing/LAG or reset HCA/GPU/switch automatically; follow coordinated network recovery and quarantine if both exact paths do not return healthy.
